content.short: Hyperstable is a Hyperliquid CDP protocol minting USH, an over-collateralized stablecoin.
content.description: Hyperstable lets users lock collateral on Hyperliquid and mint USH against it, an over-collateralised stablecoin rather than one backed by off-chain reserves. A locally issued stablecoin gives the chain a dollar that does not depend on a bridge staying solvent, which is the main counterparty risk a young network carries.
content.meta: USH, a stablecoin minted against Hyperliquid collateral rather than off-chain reserves.
